translations.literal: Yu Yi, on account of family and state affairs, left his son Fangzhi as General Who Establishes Martiality, garrisoning Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yi, on account of family and state affairs, left his son Fangzhi as general who establishes martiality, garrisoning Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 方之年少，以參軍毛穆之為建武司馬以輔之。

translations.literal: Fangzhi being young, he made staff officer Mao Muzhi Jianwu Sima to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: Fangzhi being young, he made staff officer Mao Muzhi jianwu sima to assist him.

sentences.zh: 穆之，寶之子也。

translations.literal: Muzhi was the son of Bao.
translations.idiomatic: Muzhi was the son of Bao.

sentences.zh: 翼還鎮夏口，詔翼復督江州，又領豫州刺史。

translations.literal: Yi returned to his post at Xiakou; an edict restored Yi to command of Jiangzhou and additionally made him Inspector of Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yi returned to his post at Xiakou; an edict restored him to command of Jiangzhou and additionally made him inspector of Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 翼辭豫州，復欲移鎮樂鄉，詔不許。

translations.literal: Yi declined Yuzhou and again wished to move his headquarters to Lexiang; the edict did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: Yi declined Yuzhou and again wished to move his headquarters to Lexiang; the edict did not permit it.

sentences.zh: 翼仍繕修軍器，大佃積穀，以圖後舉。

translations.literal: Yi still repaired weapons and undertook great plantation to stock grain, planning a later campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Yi still repaired weapons, undertook great plantation to stock grain, and planned a later campaign.

sentences.zh: 趙王虎作河橋於靈昌津，採石為中濟，石下，輒隨流，用功五百餘萬而橋不成，虎怒，斬匠而罷。

translations.literal: Shi Hu, Prince of Zhao, built a river bridge at Lingchang Ford, quarrying stone for the central piers; whenever stone was lowered it was swept away by the current; more than five million units of labor were expended yet the bridge was not completed; Hu in anger beheaded the craftsmen and abandoned the work.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Hu built a river bridge at Lingchang Ford, quarrying stone for the central piers; whenever stone was lowered it was swept away by the current; more than five million units of labor were expended yet the bridge was not completed; in anger Hu beheaded the craftsmen and abandoned the work.

sentences.zh: 孝宗穆皇帝上之上

translations.literal: Emperor Mu of Xiaozong—Upper Chronicle, Part One.
translations.idiomatic: The Reign of Emperor Mu (Temple Name Xiaozong)—Upper Part One.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，甲戌朔，皇太后設白紗帷於太極殿，抱帝臨軒。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on jiaxu, the day of the new moon, the empress dowager set white gauze curtains in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate and held the emperor in her arms to preside at court.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month, on jiaxu, the day of the new moon, the empress dowager set white gauze curtains in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate and held the emperor in her arms to preside at court.

sentences.zh: 趙義陽公鑒鎮關中，役煩賦重，文武有長髮者，輒拔為冠纓，餘以給宮人。

translations.literal: Prince of Yiyang Jian of Zhao held Guanzhong; corvée was oppressive and taxes heavy; any civil or military officer with long hair was plucked for cap tassels, the rest given to palace women.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Yiyang Jian of Zhao held Guanzhong; corvée was oppressive and taxes heavy; any civil or military officer with long hair was plucked for cap tassels, the remainder given to palace women.

sentences.zh: 長史取發白趙王虎，虎征鑒還鄴。

translations.literal: The chief clerk sent the hair to Shi Hu; Hu summoned Jian back to Ye.
translations.idiomatic: The chief clerk sent the hair to Shi Hu; Hu summoned Jian back to Ye.

sentences.zh: 以樂平公苞代鎮長安。

translations.literal: Prince of LePing Bao was sent to replace him as commander at Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of LePing Bao was sent to replace him as commander at Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 發雍、洛、秦、并州十六萬人治長安未央宮。

translations.literal: One hundred sixty thousand men from Yong, Luo, Qin, and Bing provinces were levied to restore Weiyang Palace at Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred sixty thousand men from Yong, Luo, Qin, and Bing were levied to restore Weiyang Palace at Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 虎好獵，晚歲，體重不能跨馬，乃造獵車千乘，刻期校獵。

translations.literal: Hu loved the hunt; in his later years his weight kept him from mounting a horse, so he had a thousand hunting chariots built and fixed dates for battue hunts.
translations.idiomatic: Hu loved the hunt; in his later years his weight kept him from mounting a horse, so he had a thousand hunting chariots built and fixed dates for battue hunts.

sentences.zh: 自靈昌津南至滎陽東極陽都為獵場，使御史監察其中禽獸，有犯者罪至大辟。

translations.literal: From Lingchang Ford south to the eastern limits of Yangdu in Yingyang was made the hunting preserve; censors supervised the game within, and violators were guilty up to capital punishment.
translations.idiomatic: From Lingchang Ford south to the eastern limits of Yangdu in Yingyang was made the hunting preserve; censors supervised the game within, and violators faced punishment up to death.

sentences.zh: 民有美女，佳牛馬，御史求之不得，皆誣以犯獸，論死者百餘人。

translations.literal: Commoners with beautiful women or fine cattle and horses—the censors could not obtain them and all falsely charged them with violating the game; more than a hundred were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: When commoners had beautiful women or fine cattle and horses and the censors could not obtain them, they all falsely charged them with violating the game; more than a hundred were sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 發諸州二十六萬人修洛陽宮。

translations.literal: Two hundred sixty thousand men from the provinces were levied to repair the Luoyang palace.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred sixty thousand men from the provinces were levied to repair the Luoyang palace.

sentences.zh: 發百姓牛二萬頭，配朔州牧官。

translations.literal: Twenty thousand oxen of the people were levied and assigned to the herdsmen of Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty thousand oxen of the people were levied and assigned to the herdsmen of Shuozhou.

sentences.zh: 增置女官二十四等，東宮十二等，公侯七十餘國皆九等，大發民女三萬餘人，料為三等以配之；

translations.literal: Female offices were increased to twenty-four grades, the Eastern Palace to twelve grades, and more than seventy states of dukes and marquises each to nine grades; more than thirty thousand commoners' daughters were widely levied and graded in three classes to assign them;
translations.idiomatic: Female offices were increased to twenty-four grades, the Eastern Palace to twelve, and more than seventy states of dukes and marquises each to nine; more than thirty thousand commoners' daughters were widely levied and graded in three classes to assign them;

sentences.zh: 太子、諸公私令采發者又將萬人。

translations.literal: the crown prince and various public and private orders for collection added nearly ten thousand more.
translations.idiomatic: the crown prince and various public and private orders for collection added nearly ten thousand more.

sentences.zh: 郡縣務求美色，多強奪人妻，殺其夫及夫自殺者三千餘人。

translations.literal: Commanderies and counties strove for beauty; many forcibly seized others' wives; those whose husbands were killed or killed themselves numbered more than three thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Commanderies and counties strove for beauty; many forcibly seized others' wives; those whose husbands were killed or killed themselves numbered more than three thousand.

sentences.zh: 至鄴，虎臨軒簡第，以使者為能，封侯者十二人。

translations.literal: When they reached Ye, Hu presided at court to select ranks, rewarding envoys for ability; twelve were enfeoffed as marquises.
translations.idiomatic: When they reached Ye, Hu presided at court to select ranks, rewarding envoys for ability; twelve were enfeoffed as marquises.

sentences.zh: 荊楚、揚、徐之民流叛略盡；

translations.literal: The people of Jingchu, Yang, and Xu were nearly all fled or in rebellion;
translations.idiomatic: The people of Jingchu, Yang, and Xu had nearly all fled or rebelled;

sentences.zh: 守令坐不能綏懷，下獄誅者五十餘人。

translations.literal: prefects and magistrates guilty of failing to soothe and cherish were more than fifty imprisoned and executed.
translations.idiomatic: more than fifty prefects and magistrates were imprisoned and executed for failing to soothe and cherish the people.

sentences.zh: 金紫光祿大夫逯明因侍切諫，虎大怒，使龍騰拉殺之。

translations.literal: Golden Bell and Purple Radiance Grandee Lu Ming remonstrated sharply while in attendance; Hu in great rage had the Dragon Leap guard drag him to death.
translations.idiomatic: Golden Bell and Purple Radiance grandee Lu Ming remonstrated sharply while in attendance; Hu in great rage had the Dragon Leap guard drag him to death.

sentences.zh: 燕王皝以牛假貧民，使佃苑中，稅其什之八，自有牛者稅其七。

translations.literal: Murong Huang, Prince of Yan, lent oxen to poor commoners and had them farm in the royal parks, taxing eight-tenths; those with their own oxen paid seven-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Huang lent oxen to poor commoners and had them farm in the royal parks, taxing eight-tenths of the harvest; those with their own oxen paid seven-tenths.

sentences.zh: 記室參軍封裕上書諫，以為：「古者什一而稅，天下之中正也。

translations.literal: Recorder Feng Yu submitted a memorial of remonstrance, holding that "In antiquity one-tenth was taxed—the golden mean under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Recorder Feng Yu submitted a memorial of remonstrance, holding that "In antiquity one-tenth was taxed—the golden mean under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 降及魏、晉，仁政衰薄，假官田官牛者不過稅其什六，自在有牛者中分之，猶不取其七八也。

translations.literal: Down to Wei and Jin, humane government declined; those farming government land with government oxen paid no more than six-tenths; those with their own oxen split the harvest in half—still not seizing seven or eight parts.
translations.idiomatic: Down to Wei and Jin humane government declined; those farming government land with government oxen paid no more than six-tenths; those with their own oxen split the harvest in half—still not seizing seven or eight parts.

sentences.zh: 自永嘉以來，海內蕩析，武宣王綏之以德，華夷之民，萬里輻湊，襁負而歸之者，若赤子之歸父母。

translations.literal: Since Yongjia the realm within the seas has been torn apart; the Martial and August king soothed it with virtue, and Chinese and barbarian peoples converged from ten thousand li, those bearing infants on their backs returning like newborns to parents.
translations.idiomatic: Since Yongjia the realm within the seas has been torn apart; the Martial and August king soothed it with virtue, and Chinese and barbarian peoples converged from ten thousand li, those bearing infants on their backs returning like newborns to their parents.

sentences.zh: 是以戶口十倍於舊，無用者什有三四。

translations.literal: Thus registered households are ten times the old figure, yet three or four tenths are nonproducers.
translations.idiomatic: Thus registered households are ten times the old figure, yet three or four tenths are nonproducers.

sentences.zh: 及殿下繼統，南摧強趙，東兼高句麗，北取宇文，拓地三千里，增民十萬戶，是宜悉罷苑囿以賦新民，無牛者官賜之牛，不當更收重稅也。

translations.literal: When Your Highness succeeded, you crushed powerful Zhao in the south, absorbed Koguryŏ in the east, and took the Yuwen in the north, extending territory three thousand li and adding a hundred thousand households—you ought to abolish all parks and estates to settle new subjects, and where there are no oxen the state should gift oxen, not impose heavier taxes again.
translations.idiomatic: When Your Highness succeeded you crushed powerful Zhao in the south, absorbed Koguryŏ in the east, and took the Yuwen in the north, extending territory three thousand li and adding a hundred thousand households—you ought to abolish all parks and estates to settle new subjects, and where there are no oxen the state should gift oxen, not impose heavier taxes again.

sentences.zh: 且以殿下之民用殿下之牛，牛非殿下之有，將何在哉！

translations.literal: Moreover, if Your Highness's people use Your Highness's oxen—yet the oxen are not truly Your Highness's possession—where then will they be!
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, if Your Highness's people use Your Highness's oxen—yet the oxen are not truly Your Highness's possession—where then will they be!

sentences.zh: 如此，則戎旗南指之日，民誰不簞食壺漿以迎王師，石虎誰與處矣！

translations.literal: Thus, when the martial banners point south, which subject would not bring rice in baskets and broth in jars to welcome the royal army—who would stand with Shi Hu!
translations.idiomatic: Thus, when the martial banners point south, which subject would not bring rice in baskets and broth in jars to welcome the royal army—who would stand with Shi Hu!

sentences.zh: 川瀆溝渠有廢塞者，皆應通利，旱由灌溉，潦則疏洩。

translations.literal: Rivers, streams, ditches, and canals that are blocked should all be cleared; in drought, irrigate; in flood, drain.
translations.idiomatic: Rivers, streams, ditches, and canals that are blocked should all be cleared; in drought, irrigate; in flood, drain.

sentences.zh: 一夫不耕，或受之饑。

translations.literal: If one man does not plow, others may suffer hunger from it.
translations.idiomatic: If one man does not plow, others may suffer hunger from it.

sentences.zh: 況游食數萬，何以得家給人足乎？

translations.literal: How much less when tens of thousands live idly on others' grain can households be full and people content?
translations.idiomatic: How much less when tens of thousands live idly on others' grain can households be full and people content?

sentences.zh: 今官司猥多，虛費廩祿，苟才不周用，皆宜澄汰。

translations.literal: Now official posts are excessive, wasting granary stipends; wherever talent does not meet the need, all should be screened and reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Now official posts are excessive, wasting granary stipends; wherever talent does not meet the need, all should be screened and reduced.

sentences.zh: 工商末利，宜立常員。

translations.literal: For merchants and craftsmen—the marginal profits—they should have fixed establishments.
translations.idiomatic: For merchants and craftsmen—the marginal profits—they should have fixed establishments.

sentences.zh: 學生三年無成，徒塞英俊之路，皆當歸之於農。

translations.literal: Students who in three years achieve nothing merely block the path of talented men—all should be returned to farming.
translations.idiomatic: Students who after three years achieve nothing merely block the path of the talented—all should be sent back to the fields.

sentences.zh: 殿下聖德寬明，博采芻蕘。

translations.literal: Your Highness's sagely virtue is broad and enlightened, widely gathering even grass-cutters' counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Your Highness's sagely virtue is broad and enlightened, and you widely gather counsel even from the humblest.

sentences.zh: 參軍王憲、大夫劉明並以言事忤旨，主者處以大辟，殿下雖恕其死，猶免官禁錮。

translations.literal: Army aides Wang Xian and Grandee Liu Ming both offended the ruler's intent by speaking on affairs; the authorities sentenced them to execution; though Your Highness spared their lives, they were still stripped of office and confined.
translations.idiomatic: The army aides Wang Xian and grandee Liu Ming both offended you by speaking frankly on state affairs; the authorities sentenced them to death; though Your Highness spared their lives, they were still dismissed and confined.

sentences.zh: 夫求諫諍而罪直言，是猶適越而北行，必不獲其所志矣！

translations.literal: To seek remonstrance yet punish straight speech is like going to Yue and traveling north—you will surely not attain your aim!
translations.idiomatic: To invite remonstrance yet punish frank speech is like setting out for Yue and traveling north—you cannot reach your goal.

sentences.zh: 右長史宋該等阿媚苟容，輕劾諫士，己無骨鯁，嫉人有之，掩蔽耳目，不忠之甚者也。

translations.literal: Right Chief Clerk Song Gai and others flattered and accommodated base desires, lightly impeaching remonstrators; themselves boneless, they envied those with backbone, covering eyes and ears—the height of disloyalty.
translations.idiomatic: Right chief clerk Song Gai and his circle flattered and indulged, lightly impeaching remonstrators; themselves without backbone, they envied those who had it, covering eyes and ears—disloyalty in the extreme.

sentences.zh: 」皝乃下令，稱：「覽封記室之諫，孤實懼焉。

translations.literal: " Huang thereupon issued an order, stating: "Having read Recorder Feng's remonstrance, I am truly afraid.
translations.idiomatic: " Murong Huang then issued an order: "Having read Recorder Feng's memorial, I am truly afraid.

sentences.zh: 國以民為本，民以谷為命，可悉罷苑囿以給民之無田者。

translations.literal: The state takes the people as its root; the people take grain as their life. All parks and estates may be abolished to grant to those among the people without fields.
translations.idiomatic: The state rests on the people; the people live on grain. Let all royal parks and estates be abolished and given to those without land.

sentences.zh: 實貧者，官與之牛；

translations.literal: Those truly poor—the government will grant them oxen;
translations.idiomatic: For the truly poor, the government will provide oxen;

sentences.zh: 力有餘願得官牛者，並依魏、晉舊法，溝瀆果有益者，令以時修治。

translations.literal: Those with surplus strength who wish government oxen shall all follow Wei and Jin old laws; wherever ditches and canals are truly beneficial, order timely repair.
translations.idiomatic: Those with surplus strength who wish to use government oxen shall follow the Wei and Jin precedents; wherever ditches and canals would truly benefit, order them repaired in season.

sentences.zh: 今戎事方興，勳伐既多，歲未可喊，俟中原平一，徐更議之。

translations.literal: Now military affairs are rising, meritorious campaigns are many, the year's levies cannot yet be reduced; wait until the Central Plains are pacified, then discuss changes slowly.
translations.idiomatic: With war underway and many campaigns for merit, levies cannot yet be cut; wait until the Central Plains are unified, then reconsider.

sentences.zh: 工商、學生皆當裁擇。

translations.literal: Merchants, craftsmen, and students should all be screened and chosen.
translations.idiomatic: Merchants, craftsmen, and students alike should be screened.

sentences.zh: 夫人臣關言於人主，至難也，雖有狂妄，當擇其善者而從之。

translations.literal: For a subject to speak frankly to his lord is supremely difficult; even if there is wildness, one should choose what is good and follow it.
translations.idiomatic: For a minister to speak frankly to his sovereign is exceedingly hard; even when words are rash, one should heed what is good in them.

sentences.zh: 王憲、劉明，雖罪應廢黜，亦由孤之無大量也，可悉復本官，仍居諫司。

translations.literal: Wang Xian and Liu Ming, though their offense deserved dismissal, it was also due to my want of great magnanimity; they may all be restored to their former posts and remain in the remonstrance offices.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xian and Liu Ming, though their offenses merited dismissal, that too arose from my own lack of magnanimity; let them all be restored to their former offices and remain in the remonstrance posts.

sentences.zh: 封生蹇蹇，深得王臣之體，其賜錢五萬。

translations.literal: Master Feng is steadfast and urgent, deeply grasping the substance of a royal minister; let him be granted fifty thousand cash.
translations.idiomatic: Feng's steadfast remonstrance embodies the true minister's duty; grant him fifty thousand cash.

sentences.zh: 宣示內外，有欲陳孤過者，不拘貴賤，勿有所諱！

translations.literal: Proclaim within and without: whoever wishes to state my faults, without regard to noble or base, let nothing be concealed!
translations.idiomatic: Proclaim throughout the realm: whoever wishes to state my faults, noble or humble alike, let nothing be withheld!

sentences.zh: 」皝雅好文學，常親臨庠序講授，考校學徒至千餘人，頗有妄濫者，故封裕及之。

translations.literal: " Huang was by nature fond of literature, often personally attending the school to lecture and examine students to more than a thousand; there were many admitted without due cause, hence Feng Yu mentioned it.
translations.idiomatic: " Murong Huang loved letters by nature, often lecturing in person at the school and examining more than a thousand students, many admitted without merit—hence Feng Yu's remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 詔征衛將軍褚裒，欲以為揚州刺史、錄尚書事。

translations.literal: An edict summoned Defender-General Chu Pou, intending to make him Governor of Yangzhou and Recorder of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: An edict summoned Defender-General Chu Pou, intending to appoint him Governor of Yangzhou and Recorder of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書劉遐、長史王胡之說裒曰：「會稽王令德雅望，國之周公也，足下宜以大政授之。

translations.literal: Minister of the Civil Service Liu Xia and Chief Clerk Wang Huzhi urged Pou, saying: "The Prince of Kuaiji's virtue and elegant reputation make him the Duke of Zhou of the state; you ought to entrust great affairs to him.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of the Civil Service Liu Xia and chief clerk Wang Huzhi urged Pou: "The Prince of Kuaiji's virtue and reputation make him the state's Duke of Zhou; you ought to entrust supreme authority to him.

sentences.zh: 」裒乃固辭，歸籓。

translations.literal: " Pou then firmly declined and returned to his fief.
translations.idiomatic: " Pou then firmly declined and returned to his fief.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以會稽王昱為撫軍大將軍，錄尚書六條事。

translations.literal: On renxu, the Prince of Kuaiji, Sima Yu, was made General of Agitating the Army and Recorder of Six Articles of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the Prince of Kuaiji, Sima Yu, was made General of Agitating the Army and Recorder of the Six Secretariat Articles.

sentences.zh: 昱清虛寡慾，尤善玄言，常以劉惔、王濛及穎川韓伯為談客，又辟郗超為撫軍掾，謝萬為從事中郎。

translations.literal: Yu was pure and sparing of desires, especially skilled in Dark Learning; he often took Liu Tan, Wang Meng, and Yingchuan's Han Bo as conversation guests; he also appointed Xi Chao as staff officer of the Agitating Army and Xie Wan as Secretariat Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Yu was pure and sparing of desire, especially skilled in Dark Learning; he often took Liu Tan, Wang Meng, and Han Bo of Yingchuan as conversationalists, and also appointed Xi Chao as staff officer of the Agitating Army and Xie Wan as Secretariat Attendant.

sentences.zh: 超，鑒之孫也，少卓犖不羈。

translations.literal: Chao was the grandson of Xi Jian; in youth he was outstanding and unrestrained.
translations.idiomatic: Chao was Xi Jian's grandson; in youth he was outstanding and unrestrained.

sentences.zh: 父愔，簡默沖退而嗇於財，積錢至數千萬，嘗開庫任超所取；

translations.literal: His father Xi Yin was plain, silent, retiring, and stingy with wealth, amassing cash to tens of millions; he once opened the treasury and let Chao take as he wished;
translations.idiomatic: His father Xi Yin was plain, silent, retiring, and miserly, amassing cash to tens of millions; he once opened the treasury and let Chao take as he wished;

sentences.zh: 超散施親故，一日都盡。

translations.literal: Chao distributed it to kin and friends and in one day spent it all.
translations.idiomatic: Chao distributed it to kin and friends and in a single day spent it all.

sentences.zh: 萬，安之弟也，清曠秀邁，亦有時名。

translations.literal: Wan was the younger brother of Xie An; pure, open, and elegantly lofty, he too had a name of the age.
translations.idiomatic: Wan was Xie An's younger brother—pure, open, and elegantly lofty—and he too enjoyed a reputation of the day.

sentences.zh: 燕有黑龍、白龍見於龍山，交首遊戲，解角而去。

translations.literal: In Yan a black dragon and a white dragon appeared on Dragon Mountain, heads intertwined in play, then shed their horns and departed.
translations.idiomatic: In Yan a black dragon and a white dragon appeared on Dragon Mountain, their heads intertwined at play, then shed their horns and departed.

sentences.zh: 燕王皝親祀以太牢，赦其境內，命所居新宮曰和龍。

translations.literal: Murong Huang personally sacrificed with the grand victim, amnestied his realm, and named the new palace where he dwelt Helong (Harmonious Dragon).
translations.idiomatic: Murong Huang personally sacrificed with the grand victim, amnestied his realm, and named his new palace Helong—Harmonious Dragon.

sentences.zh: 都亭肅侯庾翼疽發於背。

translations.literal: Viscount Su of Duting, Yu Yi, developed an abscess on his back.
translations.idiomatic: Viscount Su of Duting, Yu Yi, developed an abscess on his back.

sentences.zh: 表子爰之行輔國將軍、荊州刺史，委以後任；

translations.literal: He memorialized that his son Yuanzhi be made General of Assisting the State and Governor of Jing, entrusting him with later duties;
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that his son Yuanzhi be made General of Assisting the State and Governor of Jing, entrusting him with his later duties;

sentences.zh: 司馬義陽朱燾為南蠻校尉，以千人守巴陵。

translations.literal: Zhu Dan of Yiyang, acting as marshal, was made Colonel of the Southern Barbarians, with a thousand men to hold Baling.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Dan of Yiyang, serving as marshal, was made Colonel of the Southern Barbarians, with a thousand men to hold Baling.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，庚午，卒。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on gengwu, he died.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on gengwu, he died.

sentences.zh: 翼部將干瓚等作亂，殺冠軍將軍曹據。

translations.literal: Yi's subordinate generals Gan Zan and others rebelled and killed General of the Champions Cao Ju.
translations.idiomatic: Yi's subordinate generals Gan Zan and others rebelled and killed General of the Champions Cao Ju.

sentences.zh: 朱燾與安西長史江虨，建武司馬毛穆之、將軍袁真等共誅之。

translations.literal: Zhu Dan with Western Pacification Chief Clerk Jiang Bin, Jianwu Marshal Mao Muzhi, and General Yuan Zhen and others jointly executed them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Dan, with Western Pacification chief clerk Jiang Bin, Jianwu marshal Mao Muzhi, and general Yuan Zhen and others, jointly executed them.

sentences.zh: 虨，統之子也。

translations.literal: Bin was the son of Jiang Tong.
translations.idiomatic: Bin was Jiang Tong's son.

sentences.zh: 八月，豫州刺史路永叛奔趙，趙王虎使永屯壽春。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Governor of Yu Province Lu Yong rebelled and fled to Zhao; Zhao Prince Shi Hu had Yong garrison Shouchun.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Governor of Yu Province Lu Yong rebelled and fled to Zhao; Zhao prince Shi Hu had Yong garrison Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 庾翼既卒，朝議皆以諸庾世在西籓，人情所安，宜依翼所請，以庾爰之代其任。

translations.literal: After Yi died, court discussion held that since the Yu clan for generations held the western frontier and the people's sentiments were settled by it, they should follow Yi's request and have Yu Yuanzhi succeed him.
translations.idiomatic: After Yi died, court discussion held that since the Yu clan for generations had held the western frontier and the people were accustomed to them, they should follow Yi's request and have Yu Yuanzhi succeed him.

sentences.zh: 何充曰：「荊楚，國之西門，戶口百萬。

translations.literal: He Chong said: "Jing and Chu are the state's western gate, with a million registered households.
translations.idiomatic: He Chong said: "Jing and Chu are the state's western gate, with a million households.

sentences.zh: 北帶強胡，西鄰勁蜀，地勢險阻，周旋萬里。

translations.literal: Bordering powerful barbarians to the north and vigorous Shu to the west, the terrain is perilous and extends ten thousand li in circuit.
translations.idiomatic: It borders powerful barbarians to the north and vigorous Shu to the west; the terrain is perilous and the frontier stretches ten thousand li.

sentences.zh: 得人則中原可定，失人則社稷可憂，陸抗所謂『存則吳存，亡則吳亡』者也，豈可以白面少年當之哉！

translations.literal: With the right man the Central Plains can be settled; lose him and the altars may be endangered—what Lu Kang called 'if Wu exists, he exists; if Wu perishes, he perishes'—how can a pale-faced youth bear this burden!
translations.idiomatic: With the right man the Central Plains can be secured; lose him and the altars may be imperiled—what Lu Kang meant by 'if Wu stands, he stands; if Wu falls, he falls'—how can a pale-faced youth bear this!

sentences.zh: 桓溫英略過人，有文武器干。

translations.literal: Huan Wen's heroic strategy surpassed others; he had both civil and military talent.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Wen's heroic strategy surpassed others; he possessed both civil and military gifts.

sentences.zh: 西夏之任，無出溫者。

translations.literal: For duties in the western Xia regions, none surpasses Wen.
translations.idiomatic: For the western frontier, none surpasses Wen.

sentences.zh: 」議者又曰：「庾爰之肯避溫乎？

translations.literal: " The discussants said again: "Will Yu Yuanzhi yield to Wen?
translations.idiomatic: " The discussants said again: "Will Yu Yuanzhi yield to Wen?

sentences.zh: 如令阻兵，恥懼不淺。

translations.literal: If he were to block the army with arms, shame and fear would be no small matter.
translations.idiomatic: If he were to hold troops and resist, shame and fear would be no small matter.

sentences.zh: 」充曰：「溫足以制之，諸君勿憂。

translations.literal: " Chong said: "Wen is sufficient to control him; do not worry, gentlemen.
translations.idiomatic: " Chong said: "Wen is sufficient to control him; do not worry, gentlemen.

sentences.zh: 丹楊尹劉惔每奇溫才，然知其有不臣之志，謂會稽王昱曰：「溫不可使居形勝之地，其位號常宜抑之。

translations.literal: Governor of Danyang Liu Tan often marveled at Wen's talent, yet knew he harbored unruly ambitions; he told the Prince of Kuaiji, Sima Yu: "Wen must not be placed in a strategically decisive region; his rank and title should constantly be kept down.
translations.idiomatic: Governor of Danyang Liu Tan often marveled at Wen's talent, yet knew he harbored disloyal ambitions; he told the Prince of Kuaiji: "Wen must not be placed in a strategically decisive post; his rank and title should constantly be held down.

sentences.zh: 」勸昱自鎮上流，以己為軍司，昱不聽；

translations.literal: " He urged Yu personally to guard the upper reaches, with Tan himself as army marshal; Yu would not listen;
translations.idiomatic: " He urged Yu personally to guard the upper reaches, with Tan himself as army marshal; Yu would not listen;

sentences.zh: 又請自行，亦不聽。

translations.literal: he asked again to go himself—again Yu would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: He asked again to go himself—again Yu would not listen.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以徐州刺史桓溫為安西將軍、持節、都督荊、司、雍、益、梁、寧六州諸軍事、領護南蠻校尉、荊州刺史，爰之果不敢爭，又以劉惔監沔中諸軍事，領義成太守，代庾方之。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Governor of Xu Province Huan Wen was made General of Pacifying the West, Bearer of the Staff, Commander of military affairs in the six provinces Jing, Si, Yong, Yi, Liang, and Ning, Colonel Protecting the Southern Barbarians, and Governor of Jing; Yuanzhi indeed did not dare contend; Liu Tan was also made Supervisor of military affairs in the Mian region and Administrator of Yicheng, replacing Yu Fangzhi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Governor of Xu Province Huan Wen was made General of Pacifying the West, Bearer of the Staff, Commander of military affairs in Jing, Si, Yong, Yi, Liang, and Ning, Colonel Protecting the Southern Barbarians, and Governor of Jing; Yuanzhi indeed did not dare contend; Liu Tan was also made Supervisor of military affairs in the Mian region and Administrator of Yicheng, replacing Yu Fangzhi.

sentences.zh: 徙方之、爰之於豫章。

translations.literal: Fangzhi and Yuanzhi were transferred to Yuzhang.
translations.idiomatic: Fangzhi and Yuanzhi were transferred to Yuzhang.

sentences.zh: 桓溫嘗乘雪欲獵，先過劉惔，惔見其裝束甚嚴，謂之曰：「老賊欲持此何為？

translations.literal: Huan Wen once, riding the snow and wishing to hunt, first called on Liu Tan; Tan saw his equipment very strict and said to him: "Old bandit, what do you mean to do with all this?
translations.idiomatic: Huan Wen once, riding through the snow to hunt, first called on Liu Tan; Tan saw his equipment very strict and said: "Old bandit, what do you mean to do with all this?

sentences.zh: 」溫笑曰：「我不為此，卿安得坐談乎！

translations.literal: " Wen smiled and said: "If I did not do this, how could you sit and talk idly!
translations.idiomatic: " Wen smiled and said: "If I did not do this, how could you sit and talk at leisure!

sentences.zh: 漢主勢之弟大將軍廣，以勢無子，求為太弟，勢不許。

translations.literal: Han ruler Li Shi's younger brother, Grand General Li Guang, because Shi had no son, asked to be made heir presumptive; Shi did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: Han ruler Li Shi's younger brother, Grand General Li Guang, because Shi had no son, asked to be made heir presumptive; Shi refused.

sentences.zh: 馬當、解思明諫曰：「陛下兄弟不多，若復有所廢，將益孤危。

translations.literal: Ma Dang and Xie Siming remonstrated, saying: "Your Majesty's brothers are not many; if yet another is cast aside, isolation and peril will only increase.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Dang and Xie Siming remonstrated: "Your Majesty's brothers are few; if yet another is cast aside, isolation and peril will only deepen.

sentences.zh: 」固請許之。

translations.literal: " They firmly begged permission.
translations.idiomatic: " They firmly begged permission.

sentences.zh: 勢疑其與廣有謀，收當、思明斬之，夷其三族。

translations.literal: Shi suspected they were plotting with Guang; he arrested Dang and Siming and executed them, exterminating their three clans.
translations.idiomatic: Shi suspected they were plotting with Guang; he arrested Dang and Siming and executed them, exterminating their three clans.

sentences.zh: 遣太保李弈襲廣於涪城，貶廣為臨邛侯，廣自殺。

translations.literal: He sent Grand Mentor Li Yi to strike Guang at Fucheng; Guang was demoted to Marquis of Linqiong and committed suicide.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Grand Mentor Li Yi to strike Guang at Fucheng; Guang was demoted to Marquis of Linqiong and took his own life.

sentences.zh: 思明被收，歎曰：「國之不亡，以我數人在也，今其殆矣！

translations.literal: Siming was arrested and sighed: "The state would not perish while we few remained—now it is nearly done!
translations.idiomatic: Siming was arrested and sighed: "The state would not perish while we few remained—now it is nearly done!

sentences.zh: 」言笑自若而死。

translations.literal: " Speaking and laughing as before, he died.
translations.idiomatic: " Speaking and laughing as before, he died.

sentences.zh: 思明有智略，敢諫諍；

translations.literal: Siming had strategy and dared remonstrate;
translations.idiomatic: Siming had strategy and dared remonstrate;

sentences.zh: 馬當素得人心。

translations.literal: Ma Dang by nature won men's hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Dang by nature won men's hearts.

sentences.zh: 及其死，士兵無不哀之。

translations.literal: At their deaths, not a soldier failed to mourn them.
translations.idiomatic: At their deaths, not a soldier failed to mourn them.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，燕王皝使慕容恪攻高句麗，拔南蘇，置戍而還。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Murong Huang sent Murong Ke to attack Koguryŏ, took Nansu, stationed a garrison, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, Murong Huang sent Murong Ke to attack Koguryŏ, took Nansu, posted a garrison, and returned.

sentences.zh: 十二月，張駿伐焉耆，降之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Zhang Jun attacked Yanqi and it surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Zhang Jun attacked Yanqi and it surrendered.

sentences.zh: 是歲，駿分武威等十一郡為涼州，以世子重華為刺史；

translations.literal: That year, Jun divided eleven commanderies including Wuwei into Liang Province, with his heir Chonghua as governor;
translations.idiomatic: That year, Jun divided eleven commanderies including Wuwei into Liang Province, appointing his heir Chonghua governor;

sentences.zh: 分興晉等八郡為河州，以寧戎校尉張瓘為刺史；

translations.literal: he divided eight commanderies including Xingjin into He Province, with Colonel Pacifying the Rong Zhang Guan as governor;
translations.idiomatic: he divided eight commanderies including Xingjin into He Province, appointing Colonel Pacifying the Rong Zhang Guan governor;

sentences.zh: 分敦煌等三郡及西域都護等三營為沙州，以西胡校尉楊宣為刺史。

translations.literal: he divided three commanderies including Dunhuang and three camps of the Protectorate of the Western Regions into Sha Province, with Colonel of the Western Barbarians Yang Xuan as governor.
translations.idiomatic: he divided three commanderies including Dunhuang and three camps of the Western Regions Protectorate into Sha Province, appointing Colonel of the Western Barbarians Yang Xuan governor.

sentences.zh: 駿自稱大都督、大將軍、假涼王，督攝三州，始置祭酒、郎中、大夫、舍人、謁者等官，官員皆仿天朝而微變其名，車服旌族擬於王者。

translations.literal: Jun styled himself Grand Commander, Grand General, and Acting Prince of Liang, overseeing the three provinces; he first established offices such as Libationer, Gentleman, Grandee, Attendant, and Usher; all officials imitated the imperial court with slight changes to titles; chariots, robes, banners, and flags rivaled a king's.
translations.idiomatic: Jun styled himself Grand Commander, Grand General, and Acting Prince of Liang, overseeing the three provinces; he first established offices such as Libationer, Gentleman, Grandee, Attendant, and Usher; all officials imitated the imperial court with slight changes to titles; chariots, robes, banners, and pennons rivaled a king's.

sentences.zh: 趙王虎以冠軍將軍姚弋仲為持節、十郡六夷大都督、冠軍大將軍。

translations.literal: Zhao Prince Shi Hu made General of the Champions Yao Yizhong Bearer of the Staff, Grand Commander of Six Tribes in Ten Commanderies, and Grand General of the Champions.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao prince Shi Hu made General of the Champions Yao Yizhong Bearer of the Staff, Grand Commander of the Six Tribes in Ten Commanderies, and Grand General of the Champions.

sentences.zh: 弋仲清儉鯁直，不治威儀，言無畏避，虎甚重之。

translations.literal: Yizhong was pure, frugal, upright, and blunt; he did not cultivate imposing ceremony; his speech knew no fear or evasion; Hu greatly valued him.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhong was pure, frugal, upright, and blunt; he cultivated no imposing ceremony; his speech knew no fear or evasion; Hu greatly valued him.

sentences.zh: 朝之大議，每與參決，公卿皆憚而下之。

translations.literal: On great deliberations of the court he joined in decisions each time; the grandees all feared him and yielded.
translations.idiomatic: On great court deliberations he joined in decisions each time; the grandees all feared him and yielded.

sentences.zh: 武城左尉，虎寵姬之弟也，嘗入弋仲營，侵擾其部眾。

translations.literal: The Left Commandant of Wucheng, younger brother of Hu's favored consort, once entered Yizhong's camp and harassed his troops.
translations.idiomatic: The left commandant of Wucheng, younger brother of Hu's favored consort, once entered Yizhong's camp and harassed his troops.

sentences.zh: 弋仲執而數之曰：「爾為禁尉，迫脅小民，我為大臣，目所親見，不可縱也。

translations.literal: Yizhong seized him and rebuked him, saying: "You serve as an imperial guard, coercing little people; I am a great minister and saw it with my own eyes—it cannot be indulged.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhong seized him and rebuked him: "You serve as an imperial guard, coercing common people; I am a great minister and saw it with my own eyes—it cannot be indulged.

sentences.zh: 」命左右斬之。

translations.literal: " He ordered his attendants to behead him.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered his attendants to behead him.

sentences.zh: 尉叩頭流血，左右固諫，乃止。

translations.literal: The commandant kowtowed until his head bled; attendants firmly remonstrated, and he stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The commandant kowtowed until his head bled; attendants firmly remonstrated, and he stopped.

sentences.zh: 燕王皝以為古者諸侯即位，各稱元年，於是始不用晉年號，自稱十二年。

translations.literal: Murong Huang held that in antiquity when feudal lords took the throne each called his own first year; thereby he first ceased using Jin reign titles and styled his reign the twelfth year.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Huang held that in antiquity when feudal lords took the throne each called his own first year; thereby he first ceased using Jin reign titles and styled his reign the twelfth year.

sentences.zh: 趙王虎使征東將軍鄧恆將兵數萬屯樂安，治攻具，為取燕之計。

translations.literal: Zhao Prince Shi Hu had Eastern Campaign General Deng Heng lead troops numbering tens of thousands to camp at Le'an, preparing siege engines, planning to take Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao prince Shi Hu had Eastern Campaign General Deng Heng lead tens of thousands of troops to camp at Le'an, preparing siege engines, planning to take Yan.

sentences.zh: 燕王皝以慕容霸為平狄將軍，戍徒河；

translations.literal: Murong Huang made Murong Ba General of Pacifying the Di and garrisoned Tujin;
translations.idiomatic: Murong Huang made Murong Ba General of Pacifying the Di and garrisoned him at Tujin;

sentences.zh: 恆畏之，不敢犯。

translations.literal: Heng feared him and did not dare invade.
translations.idiomatic: Heng feared him and did not dare invade.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，丙寅，大赦。

translations.literal: Spring, first month, on bingyin, a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month, on bingyin, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，都鄉文穆侯何充卒。

translations.literal: On jimao, Marquis Wenmu of Duxiang, He Chong, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Marquis Wenmu of Duxiang, He Chong, died.

sentences.zh: 充有器局，臨朝正色，以社稷為己任，所選用皆以功效，不私親舊。

translations.literal: Chong had capacity and farseeing judgment; at court he kept a grave demeanor and took the altars as his personal charge; those he selected and employed were all judged by effectiveness, not favoring kin or old associates.
translations.idiomatic: Chong had capacity and judgment; at court he kept a grave demeanor and took the altars as his personal charge; those he selected and employed were judged by merit, not favoring kin or old associates.

sentences.zh: 初，夫餘居於鹿山，為百濟所侵，部落衰散，西徙近燕，而不設備。

translations.literal: Initially Fuyu dwelt on Deer Mountain; invaded by Paekche, the tribes scattered and declined; they moved west near Yan yet made no preparations.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Fuyu dwelt on Deer Mountain; invaded by Paekche, its tribes scattered and declined; it moved west near Yan yet made no preparations.

sentences.zh: 燕王皝遣世子俊帥慕容軍、慕容恪、慕輿根三將軍、萬七千騎襲夫餘。

translations.literal: Murong Huang sent the heir-apparent Jun leading three generals—Murong Jun, Murong Ke, and Murong Gen—and seventeen thousand cavalry to raid Fuyu.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Huang sent the heir-apparent Jun at the head of three generals—Murong Jun, Murong Ke, and Murong Gen—and seventeen thousand cavalry to raid Fuyu.

sentences.zh: 俊居中指授，軍事皆以任恪。

translations.literal: Jun sat at center directing; all military affairs were entrusted to Ke.
translations.idiomatic: Jun sat at center directing operations; all military affairs were entrusted to Ke.

sentences.zh: 遂拔夫餘，虜其王玄及部落五萬餘口而還。

translations.literal: They then took Fuyu, captured King Xuan and more than fifty thousand of the tribe, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: They then took Fuyu, captured King Xuan and more than fifty thousand of the tribe, and returned.

sentences.zh: 皝以玄為鎮軍將軍，妻以女。

translations.literal: Huang made Xuan General of Garrisoning the Army and gave him a daughter in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: Huang made Xuan General of Garrisoning the Army and gave him a daughter in marriage.

sentences.zh: 二月，癸丑，以左光祿大夫蔡謨領司徒，與會稽王昱同輔政。

translations.literal: Second month, on guichou, Left Household Grandee Cai Mo was made acting Minister of Education, jointly assisting government with the Prince of Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guichou, Left Household Grandee Cai Mo was made acting Minister of Education, to assist government jointly with the Prince of Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 褚裒薦前光祿大夫顧和、前司徒左長史殷浩；

translations.literal: Chu Pou recommended former Household Grandee Gu He and former Left Chief Clerk of the Minister of Education Yin Hao;
translations.idiomatic: Chu Pou recommended former Household Grandee Gu He and former left chief clerk of the Minister of Education Yin Hao;

sentences.zh: 三月，丙子，以和為尚書令，浩為建武將軍、揚州刺史。

translations.literal: Third month, on bingzi, He was made Director of the Secretariat and Hao made General of Establishing Martial Prowess and Governor of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingzi, He was made Director of the Secretariat and Hao General of Establishing Martial Prowess and Governor of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 和有母喪，固辭不起，謂所親曰：「古人有釋衰絰從王者，以其才足干時故也。

translations.literal: He was in mourning for his mother and firmly declined to take office; he told those close to him: "In antiquity some cast off mourning bands to follow kings because their talent sufficed to sustain the age.
translations.idiomatic: He was in mourning for his mother and firmly declined office; he told those close to him: "In antiquity some cast off mourning bands to follow kings because their talent sufficed to sustain the age.

sentences.zh: 如和者，正足以虧孝道、傷風俗耳。

translations.literal: One like He would only enough to impair filial duty and harm custom.
translations.idiomatic: One like me would only impair filial duty and harm custom.

sentences.zh: 」識者美之。

translations.literal: " Those of insight praised him.
translations.idiomatic: " Those of insight praised him.

sentences.zh: 浩亦固辭。

translations.literal: Hao also firmly declined.
translations.idiomatic: Hao also firmly declined.

sentences.zh: 會稽王昱與浩書曰：「屬當厄運，危弊理極，足下沈識淹長，足以經濟。

translations.literal: The Prince of Kuaiji, Sima Yu, wrote to Hao: "We face ill fortune; peril and decay have reached their limit. You have profound knowledge and long experience, enough to sustain the state.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Kuaiji wrote to Hao: "We face ill fortune; peril and decay have reached their limit. Your profound knowledge and long experience are enough to sustain the state.

sentences.zh: 若復深存挹退，苟遂本懷，吾恐天下之事於此去矣。

translations.literal: If you again deeply preserve modest withdrawal and simply follow your original wish, I fear the affairs of the realm at this point will pass away.
translations.idiomatic: If you again deeply preserve modest withdrawal and simply follow your original wish, I fear the realm's affairs will slip away at this very moment.

sentences.zh: 足下去就，即時之廢興，則家國不異，足下宜深思之。

translations.literal: Your going or staying at this moment is the rise or fall of the age; then family and state are not different—you should ponder this deeply.
translations.idiomatic: Your going or staying at this moment is the rise or fall of the age; family and state are one—you should ponder this deeply.

sentences.zh: 」浩乃就職。

translations.literal: " Hao then took office.
translations.idiomatic: " Hao then took office.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，己酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on the first day jiyou, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the first day jiyou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 五月，丙戌，西平忠成公張駿薨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingxu, Zhang Jun, Duke of Xiping and Loyal and Accomplished, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the bingxu day, Zhang Jun, the Loyal and Accomplished Duke of Xiping, died.

sentences.zh: 官屬上世子重華為使持節、大都督、太尉、護羌校尉、涼州牧、西平公、假涼王；

translations.literal: His officials presented the heir apparent Chonghua as Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Grand Commander-in-Chief, Grand Marshal, Protector of the Qiang, Governor of Liang Province, Duke of Xiping, and Acting Prince of Liang;
translations.idiomatic: His officials installed the heir apparent Chonghua as bearer of the staff of authority, grand commander-in-chief, grand marshal, Protector of the Qiang, governor of Liang Province, Duke of Xiping, and acting Prince of Liang;

sentences.zh: 赦其境內；

translations.literal: they proclaimed an amnesty within the realm;
translations.idiomatic: they proclaimed an amnesty throughout the realm;

sentences.zh: 尊嫡母嚴氏為大王太后，母馬氏為王太后。

translations.literal: they honored his principal mother, Lady Yan, as Grand King Mother and his mother, Lady Ma, as King Mother.
translations.idiomatic: they honored his principal mother, Lady Yan, as Grand Queen Mother and his mother, Lady Ma, as Queen Mother.

sentences.zh: 趙中黃門嚴生惡尚書朱軌，會久雨，生譖軌不修道路，又謗訕朝政，趙王虎囚之。

translations.literal: Yan Sheng, a Central Yellow Gate Attendant of Zhao, hated Minister of the Masters of Writing Zhu Gui; when prolonged rain fell, Sheng slandered Gui for not repairing the roads and also reviled court affairs, and Zhao Prince Hu imprisoned him.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Sheng, a Central Yellow Gate attendant of Zhao, hated Minister of the Masters of Writing Zhu Gui; when the rains lingered, Sheng accused Gui of neglecting the roads and also reviled the government, and Zhao prince Shi Hu had him imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 蒲洪諫曰：「陛下既有襄國、鄴宮，又修長安、洛陽宮殿，將以何用？

translations.literal: Pu Hong remonstrated, saying, "Your Majesty already has palaces at Xiangguo and Ye, yet you also repair the palaces at Chang'an and Luoyang—what will they be used for?
translations.idiomatic: Pu Hong remonstrated, saying, "Your Majesty already has palaces at Xiangguo and Ye, yet you are also rebuilding the palaces at Chang'an and Luoyang—what purpose will that serve?

sentences.zh: 作獵車千乘，環數千里以養禽獸，奪人妻女十萬餘口以實後宮，聖帝明王之所為，固若是乎？

translations.literal: You build a thousand hunting chariots and ring several thousand li to keep wild beasts; you seize more than a hundred thousand men's wives and daughters to fill the inner palace—is this truly what sage emperors and enlightened kings do?
translations.idiomatic: You build a thousand hunting chariots and fence off thousands of li to keep game; you seize more than a hundred thousand wives and daughters of the people to stock the inner palace—is this what sage emperors and enlightened kings are supposed to do?

sentences.zh: 今又以道路不修，欲殺尚書。

translations.literal: Now, because the roads are not repaired, you wish to kill a minister of the masters of writing.
translations.idiomatic: Now, because the roads are not repaired, you wish to execute a minister of the masters of writing.

sentences.zh: 陛下德政不修，天降淫雨，七旬乃霽。

translations.literal: Your Majesty does not cultivate virtuous government; Heaven sends down torrential rain, and only after seventy days does it clear.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty does not cultivate virtuous government; Heaven sends down torrential rain, and it clears only after seventy days.

sentences.zh: 霽方二日，雖有鬼兵百萬，亦未能去道路之塗潦，而況人乎！

translations.literal: It has cleared barely two days; even if there were a million ghost soldiers, they could not remove the mud and standing water on the roads—how much less men!
translations.idiomatic: It has been clear barely two days; even a million ghost soldiers could not clear the mud and standing water from the roads—how much less ordinary men!

sentences.zh: 政刑如此，其如四海何！

translations.literal: When government and punishments are like this, what of the four seas!
translations.idiomatic: When government and punishments are like this, what will become of the empire!

sentences.zh: 其如後代何！

translations.literal: What of posterity!
translations.idiomatic: What will become of posterity!

sentences.zh: 願止作役，罷苑囿，出宮女，赦朱軌，以副眾望。

translations.literal: I beg that you halt labor corvée, abolish parks and enclosures, release palace women, and pardon Zhu Gui, to answer the people's hopes.
translations.idiomatic: I beg you to halt labor corvée, abolish the parks and hunting enclosures, release palace women, and pardon Zhu Gui, to meet the people's expectations.

sentences.zh: 」虎雖不悅，亦不之罪，為之罷長安、洛陽作役，而竟誅朱軌。

translations.literal: " Though Hu was displeased, he did not punish him; he halted construction at Chang'an and Luoyang on his account, yet in the end executed Zhu Gui.
translations.idiomatic: " Though Shi Hu was displeased, he did not punish Pu Hong; he halted construction at Chang'an and Luoyang on his account, yet in the end executed Zhu Gui.

sentences.zh: 又立私論朝政之法，聽吏告其君，奴告其主。

translations.literal: He also established a law for private discussion of court affairs, permitting clerks to denounce their lords and slaves to denounce their masters.
translations.idiomatic: He also established a law allowing private commentary on court affairs, permitting clerks to denounce their superiors and slaves to denounce their masters.

sentences.zh: 公卿以下，朝覲以目相顧，不必復相過從談語。

translations.literal: From the Three Dukes and ministers downward, at court audiences they exchanged glances with their eyes and no longer needed to visit one another in passing or converse.
translations.idiomatic: From the three highest ministers downward, at court audiences they only exchanged glances and no longer visited or spoke with one another.

sentences.zh: 趙將軍王擢擊張重華，襲武街，執護軍曹權、胡宣，徙七千餘戶於雍州。

translations.literal: Zhao General Wang Zhuo attacked Zhang Chonghua, raided Wujie, seized Protector of the Army Cao Quan and Hu Xuan, and moved more than seven thousand households to Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao general Wang Zhuo attacked Zhang Chonghua, raided Wujie, captured Protector of the Army Cao Quan and Hu Xuan, and relocated more than seven thousand households to Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 涼州刺史麻秋、將軍孫伏都攻金城，太守張沖請降，涼州震動。

translations.literal: Liang Province Inspector Ma Qiu and General Sun Fudu attacked Jincheng; the prefect Zhang Chong offered to surrender, and Liang Province was shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Province inspector Ma Qiu and general Sun Fudu attacked Jincheng; the prefect Zhang Chong offered to surrender, and all of Liang Province was shaken.

sentences.zh: 重華悉發境內兵，使征南將軍裴恆將之以御趙。

translations.literal: Chonghua mustered all troops within the borders and had Southern Campaign General Pei Heng lead them to resist Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: Chonghua mobilized every soldier in the realm and had Southern Campaign General Pei Heng lead them against Zhao.

sentences.zh: 恆壁於廣武，久而不戰。

translations.literal: Heng fortified at Guangwu and for a long time did not give battle.
translations.idiomatic: Heng fortified at Guangwu and for a long time refused to fight.

sentences.zh: 涼州司馬張耽言於重華曰：「國之存亡在兵，兵之勝敗在將。

translations.literal: Liang Province Marshal Zhang Dan said to Chonghua, "A state's survival or ruin lies in its armies; an army's victory or defeat lies in its generals.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Province marshal Zhang Dan said to Chonghua, "Whether a state survives or perishes depends on its armies; whether armies win or lose depends on their generals.

sentences.zh: 今議者舉將，多推宿舊。

translations.literal: Now those who discuss matters nominate generals and mostly push longstanding veterans.
translations.idiomatic: Today those who debate the matter mostly nominate longstanding veterans as generals.

sentences.zh: 夫韓信之舉，非舊德也。

translations.literal: Han Xin's elevation was not due to old merit.
translations.idiomatic: Han Xin's elevation was not based on old merit.

sentences.zh: 蓋明主之舉，舉無常人，才之所堪，則授以大事。

translations.literal: For an enlightened lord's elevation, he elevates no ordinary man; where talent can bear the burden, he entrusts great affairs.
translations.idiomatic: An enlightened ruler promotes no ordinary man; where talent can bear the burden, he entrusts it with great affairs.

sentences.zh: 今強寇在境，諸將不進，人情危懼。

translations.literal: Now a powerful foe is on the borders, the generals do not advance, and men's hearts are fearful and alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: Now a powerful enemy is at the border, the generals will not advance, and the people are gripped by fear.

sentences.zh: 主簿謝艾，兼資文武，可用以御趙。

translations.literal: Chief Clerk Xie Ai combines civil and military gifts and may be used to resist Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: Chief clerk Xie Ai is gifted in both civil and military affairs and can be used to resist Zhao.

sentences.zh: 」重華召艾，問以方略；

translations.literal: " Chonghua summoned Ai and questioned him on strategy;
translations.idiomatic: " Chonghua summoned Ai and asked him for a plan of campaign;

sentences.zh: 艾願請兵七千人，必破趙以報。

translations.literal: Ai wished to request seven thousand troops and vowed he would surely break Zhao in requital.
translations.idiomatic: Ai asked for seven thousand troops and vowed he would surely defeat Zhao in return.

sentences.zh: 重華拜艾中堅將軍，給步騎五千，使擊秋。

translations.literal: Chonghua appointed Ai General of the Central Garrison and gave him five thousand foot and horse to attack Qiu.
translations.idiomatic: Chonghua appointed Ai General of the Central Garrison, gave him five thousand infantry and cavalry, and sent him against Ma Qiu.

sentences.zh: 艾引兵出振武，夜有二梟鳴於牙中，艾曰：「六博得梟者勝。

translations.literal: Ai led his troops out from Zhenwu; at night two owls cried within the headquarters pennant, and Ai said, "In liubo, he who captures the owl wins.
translations.idiomatic: Ai led his troops out from Zhenwu; at night two owls cried within the command pennant, and Ai said, "In the game liubo, he who captures the owl wins.

sentences.zh: 今梟鳴牙中，克敵之兆也。

translations.literal: Now owls cry within the pennant—it is an omen of overcoming the foe.
translations.idiomatic: Now owls cry within the pennant—it is an omen that we will overcome the enemy.

sentences.zh: 」進與趙戰，大破之，斬首五千級。

translations.literal: " He advanced and fought Zhao, routing them greatly and taking five thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: " He advanced, gave battle to Zhao, won a great victory, and took five thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 重華封艾為福祿伯。

translations.literal: Chonghua enfeoffed Ai as Marquis of Fulu.
translations.idiomatic: Chonghua enfeoffed Ai as Marquis of Fulu.

sentences.zh: 麻秋之克金城也，縣令敦煌車濟不降，伏劍而死。

translations.literal: When Ma Qiu took Jincheng, Che Ji of Dunhuang, the county magistrate, would not surrender and died by his own sword.
translations.idiomatic: When Ma Qiu took Jincheng, Che Ji, the magistrate of Dunhuang county, refused to surrender and fell on his sword.

sentences.zh: 秋又攻大夏，護軍梁式執太守宋晏，以城應秋，秋遣晏以書誘致宛戍都尉敦煌宋矩。

translations.literal: Qiu again attacked Daxia; Protector of the Army Liang Shi seized Prefect Song Yan and surrendered the city to Qiu; Qiu sent Yan with a letter to lure in Song Ju of Dunhuang, Commandant of the Garrison at Wan.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu again attacked Daxia; Protector of the Army Liang Shi seized the prefect Song Yan and surrendered the city to Qiu; Qiu sent Yan with a letter to lure Song Ju of Dunhuang, commandant of the Wan garrison.

sentences.zh: 矩曰：「為人臣，功既不成，唯有死節耳！

translations.literal: Ju said, "As a subject of men, since merit is already unachieved, there is only dying for integrity!
translations.idiomatic: Ju said, "As a subject, since I have achieved no merit, there is only to die for my integrity!

sentences.zh: 」先殺妻子而後自刎。

translations.literal: " He first killed his wife and children and then cut his own throat.
translations.idiomatic: " He first killed his wife and children and then cut his own throat.

sentences.zh: 秋曰：「皆義士也。

translations.literal: Qiu said, "They are all men of righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu said, "They were all men of righteousness.

sentences.zh: 」收而葬之。

translations.literal: " He gathered their bodies and buried them.
translations.idiomatic: " He gathered their bodies and buried them.

sentences.zh: 冬，漢太保李弈自晉壽舉兵反，蜀人多從之，眾至數萬。

translations.literal: In winter, Han Grand Guardian Li Yi raised troops in revolt from Jinshou; many in Shu followed him, and his host reached tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, Han grand guardian Li Yi raised troops in revolt from Jinshou; many in Shu joined him, and his force grew to tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 漢主勢登城拒虞，弈單騎突門，門者射而殺之，其眾綿潰。

translations.literal: Han ruler Shi mounted the walls to resist the attack; Yi charged the gate alone on horseback, and the gate guards shot and killed him; his host collapsed like unraveling silk.
translations.idiomatic: Han ruler Li Shi mounted the walls to resist the rebels; Yi charged the gate alone on horseback, and the gate guards shot and killed him; his host collapsed in disarray.

sentences.zh: 勢大赦境內，改年嘉寧。

translations.literal: Shi proclaimed a great amnesty within the borders and changed the era name to Jianing.
translations.idiomatic: Shi proclaimed a great amnesty throughout the realm and changed the era name to Jianing.

sentences.zh: 勢驕淫，不恤國事，多居禁中，罕接公卿，疏忌舊臣，信任左右，讒謅並進，刑罰苛濫，由是中外離心。

translations.literal: Shi was arrogant and licentious, heedless of state affairs; he mostly dwelt within the forbidden quarters, rarely received the Three Dukes and ministers, was distant and jealous of old ministers, trusted those at his side, slander and flattery advanced together, punishments were harsh and excessive—thereby court and countryside lost heart.
translations.idiomatic: Shi was arrogant and dissolute and heedless of state affairs; he spent most of his time in the inner palace, rarely received the highest ministers, grew distant and suspicious of old officials, trusted only those at his side, allowed slander and flattery to flourish, and imposed harsh and excessive punishments—so that court and countryside alike lost heart.

sentences.zh: 蜀土先無獠，至是始從山出，自巴西至犍為、梓潼，佈滿山谷十餘萬落，不可禁制，大為民患。

translations.literal: Shu lands had formerly had no Liao; at this time they first came out from the mountains, from Baxi to Jianwei and Zitong, spreading through valleys in more than a hundred thousand settlements, impossible to restrain, and became a great scourge to the people.
translations.idiomatic: There had formerly been no Liao people in Shu; now they first came down from the mountains, from Baxi to Jianwei and Zitong, filling the valleys in more than a hundred thousand settlements, beyond all control, and became a great scourge upon the people.

sentences.zh: 加以饑饉，四境之內，遂至蕭條。

translations.literal: Added to this was famine; within the four borders the land came to desolation.
translations.idiomatic: Famine was added to this, and within the four borders the land fell into desolation.

sentences.zh: 安西將軍桓溫將伐漢，將佐皆以為不可。

translations.literal: Anxi General Huan Wen was about to attack Han; his generals and aides all held it impossible.
translations.idiomatic: Anxi general Huan Wen was preparing to attack Han; his generals and aides all said it could not be done.

sentences.zh: 江夏相袁喬勸之曰：「夫經略大事，固非常情所及，智者了於胸中，不必待眾言皆合也。

translations.literal: Jiangxia Chancellor Yuan Qiao urged him, saying, "Grand strategy is indeed not what ordinary sentiment can reach; the wise man comprehends it within his breast and need not wait until every voice agrees.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxia chancellor Yuan Qiao urged him, saying, "Grand strategy is not something ordinary minds can grasp; the wise man sees it clearly in his own breast and need not wait until every voice agrees.

sentences.zh: 今為天下之患者，胡、蜀二寇而已。

translations.literal: Those who afflict the realm today are only the two foes, Hu and Shu.
translations.idiomatic: The afflictions of the realm today are only the two enemies, the barbarians and Shu.

sentences.zh: 蜀雖險固，比胡為弱，將欲除之，宜先其易者。

translations.literal: Though Shu is perilous and firm, compared with Hu it is the weaker; if you wish to remove them, you should first take the easier.
translations.idiomatic: Though Shu is rugged and well defended, it is weaker than the northern foe; if you mean to eliminate them, you should strike the easier target first.

sentences.zh: 李勢無道，臣民不附，且恃其險遠，不修戰備。

translations.literal: Li Shi is without the Way; subjects and people do not adhere to him, and moreover he relies on his perilous distance and does not repair war preparations.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shi is without the Way; his subjects and people do not support him, and he relies on his rugged remoteness and neglects his defenses.

sentences.zh: 宜以精卒萬人輕繼疾趨，比其覺之，我已出其險要，可一戰擒也。

translations.literal: You should take ten thousand picked troops, travel light with scant baggage and hurry swiftly; before he is aware, we will already have passed his perilous passes and can seize him in a single battle.
translations.idiomatic: You should take ten thousand elite troops, travel light with little baggage, and march swiftly; before he realizes it, we will already be past his strategic passes and can take him in a single battle.

sentences.zh: 蜀地富饒，戶口繁庶，諸葛武侯用之抗衡中夏，若得而有之，國家之大利也。

translations.literal: Shu lands are rich and fertile, households numerous and thriving; Zhuge the Martial Lord used them to contend with central China—if we gain and hold them, it is a great profit to the state.
translations.idiomatic: Shu is rich and fertile, its population numerous; Zhuge Liang used it to contend with central China—if we gain and hold it, that is a great benefit to the state.

sentences.zh: 論者恐大軍既西，胡必窺覦，此似是而非。

translations.literal: Those who debate fear that once the great army has gone west, Hu will surely spy and covet—this seems plausible but is not so.
translations.idiomatic: Critics fear that once the main army marches west, the northern foe will surely take advantage—this seems plausible but is wrong.

sentences.zh: 胡聞我萬里遠征，以為內有重備，必不敢動；

translations.literal: When Hu hears that we make a expedition of ten thousand li, he will suppose we have heavy reserves within and surely will not dare stir;
translations.idiomatic: When the barbarians hear that we are marching on an expedition ten thousand li distant, they will assume we have strong reserves at home and will not dare stir;

sentences.zh: 縱有侵軼，緣江諸軍足以拒守，必無憂也。

translations.literal: even if there is encroachment, the armies along the river are sufficient to resist and hold—there is surely no worry.
translations.idiomatic: even if they raid, the armies along the Yangzi are sufficient to hold them off—there is nothing to fear.

sentences.zh: 」溫從之。

translations.literal: " Wen followed this.
translations.idiomatic: " Huan Wen followed his advice.

sentences.zh: 喬，瑰之子也。

translations.literal: Qiao was the son of Gui.
translations.idiomatic: Qiao was the son of Yuan Gui.

sentences.zh: 十一月，辛未，溫帥益州刺史周撫、南郡太守譙王無忌伐漢，拜表即行；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinwei, Wen led Yi Province Inspector Zhou Fu and Nanking Prefect Prince of Qiao Wu Ji to attack Han, submitted a memorial and set out at once;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the xinwei day, Huan Wen led Yi Province inspector Zhou Fu and Nanking prefect, Prince of Qiao Wu Ji, to attack Han, submitted his memorial, and marched at once;

sentences.zh: 委安西長史范汪以留事，加撫督梁州之四郡諸軍事；

translations.literal: he entrusted remaining affairs to Anxi Chief Clerk Fan Wang and added to Fu supervision of military affairs in the four commanderies of Liang Province;
translations.idiomatic: he left remaining affairs to Anxi chief clerk Fan Wang and added to Zhou Fu supervision of military affairs in the four commanderies of Liang Province;

sentences.zh: 使袁喬帥二千人為前鋒。

translations.literal: he had Yuan Qiao lead two thousand men as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: and had Yuan Qiao lead two thousand men as the vanguard.

sentences.zh: 朝廷以蜀道險遠，溫眾少而深入，皆以為憂，惟劉惔以為必克。

translations.literal: The court, because the Shu road was perilous and far and Wen's host was few yet penetrating deep, all were anxious; only Liu Tan held that he would surely conquer.
translations.idiomatic: The court, seeing that the road to Shu was perilous and distant and that Huan Wen had few troops yet was penetrating deep, was full of anxiety; only Liu Tan believed he would surely prevail.

sentences.zh: 或問其故，惔曰：「以博知之。

translations.literal: Someone asked the reason; Tan said, "I know it from gaming.
translations.idiomatic: When someone asked why, Tan said, "I know it from gaming.

sentences.zh: 溫，善博者也，不必得則不為。

translations.literal: Wen is skilled at gaming; if he is not sure of winning, he does not act.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Wen is a skilled gambler; if he is not sure of winning, he does not play.

sentences.zh: 但恐克蜀之後，溫終專制朝廷耳。

translations.literal: I only fear that after conquering Shu, Wen will in the end monopolize the court.
translations.idiomatic: I only fear that after he conquers Shu, Huan Wen will end up dominating the court.

sentences.zh: 春，二月，桓溫軍至青衣。

translations.literal: In spring, the second month, Huan Wen's army reached Qingyi.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the second month, Huan Wen's army reached Qingyi.

sentences.zh: 漢主勢大發兵，遣叔父右衛將軍福、從兄鎮南將軍權、前將軍昝堅等將之，自山陽趣合水。

translations.literal: Han ruler Shi mustered troops on a great scale, sent his uncle Right Guards General Fu, his cousin Southern Pacification General Quan, Forward General Zan Jian, and others to lead them, and himself went from Shanyang toward Heshui.
translations.idiomatic: Han ruler Li Shi mobilized a great army, sent his uncle Right Guards General Li Fu, his cousin Southern Pacification General Li Quan, Forward General Zan Jian, and others to command it, and himself marched from Shanyang toward Heshui.

sentences.zh: 諸將欲伏於江南以待晉，昝堅不從，引兵自江北鴛鴦碕渡向犍為。

translations.literal: The generals wished to lie in ambush south of the river to await Jin; Zan Jian would not follow, led troops from north of the river across at Yuanyang Ford toward Jianwei.
translations.idiomatic: The generals wished to lie in ambush south of the river to await the Jin army; Zan Jian refused, led his troops from the north bank across at Yuanyang Ford, and marched toward Jianwei.

sentences.zh: 三月，溫至彭模。

translations.literal: In the third month, Wen reached Pengmo.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Huan Wen reached Pengmo.

sentences.zh: 議者欲分為兩軍，異道俱進，以分漢兵之勢。

translations.literal: Those who deliberated wished to divide into two armies and advance by separate routes together, to split the Han army's strength.
translations.idiomatic: His advisers wished to split into two armies and advance by separate routes to divide the Han forces.

sentences.zh: 袁喬曰：「今懸軍深入萬里之外，勝則大功可立，不勝則□類無遺，當合勢齊力，以取一戰之捷。

translations.literal: Yuan Qiao said, "Now we hang our army deep ten thousand li beyond home; if we win, great merit can be established—if we do not win, then □-kind will leave none surviving; we should combine strength and unite force to seize one battle's victory.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Qiao said, "We have thrust our army deep into enemy territory ten thousand li from home; if we win, great merit can be won—if we lose, not one of us will survive; we must combine our strength and unite for a single decisive victory.

sentences.zh: 若分兩軍，則眾心不一，萬一偏敗，大事去矣。

translations.literal: If we divide into two armies, then the host's hearts will not be one; if by chance one wing is defeated, the great affair is lost.
translations.idiomatic: If we split into two armies, morale will splinter; if one wing is defeated, the whole campaign is lost.

sentences.zh: 不如全軍而進，棄去釜甑，繼三日糧，以示無還心，勝可必也。

translations.literal: Better to advance with the whole army, cast away pots and cauldrons, carry only three days' grain, to show there is no mind to return—victory can be made certain.
translations.idiomatic: Better to advance with the whole army, burn our cooking pots, carry only three days' rations, and show we have no intention of turning back—then victory is assured.

sentences.zh: 」溫從之，留參軍孫盛、周楚將贏兵守輜重，溫自將步卒直指成都。

translations.literal: " Wen followed this; he left Army Aides Sun Sheng and Zhou Chu to lead weak troops to guard the baggage train, while Wen himself led foot soldiers straight at Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: " Huan Wen agreed; he left army aides Sun Sheng and Zhou Chu with a light force to guard the baggage train, while he himself led infantry straight for Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 楚，撫之子也。

translations.literal: Chu was the son of Fu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Chu was the son of Zhou Fu.

sentences.zh: 李福進攻彭模，孫盛等奮擊，走之。

translations.literal: Li Fu advanced to attack Pengmo; Sun Sheng and the others struck fiercely and drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fu advanced to attack Pengmo; Sun Sheng and the others fought fiercely and drove him off.

sentences.zh: 溫進，遇李權，三戰三捷，漢兵散走歸成都，鎮東將軍李位都迎詣溫降。

translations.literal: Wen advanced, met Li Quan, fought three battles and won three victories; Han troops scattered and fled back to Chengdu; Eastern Pacification General Li Weidu came out to meet Wen and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Wen advanced, met Li Quan, and won three battles in succession; Han troops scattered and fled back to Chengdu; Eastern Pacification General Li Weidu came out to meet him and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 昝堅至犍為，乃知與溫異道，還，自沙頭津濟，比至，溫已軍於成都之十里陌，堅眾自潰。

translations.literal: Zan Jian reached Jianwei and only then learned he was on a different route from Wen; he returned, crossed from Shatou Ford, and by the time he arrived Wen had already encamped at the Ten-Li Mound outside Chengdu—Jian's host collapsed of itself.
translations.idiomatic: Zan Jian reached Jianwei and only then learned he was on a different route from Huan Wen; he turned back, crossed at Shatou Ford, and by the time he arrived Huan Wen had already encamped at the Ten-Li Mound outside Chengdu—Jian's force collapsed on its own.

sentences.zh: 勢悉眾出戰於成都之笮橋，溫前鋒不利，參軍龔護戰死，矢及溫馬首。

translations.literal: Shi led out his entire host to give battle at the Zha Bridge of Chengdu; Wen's vanguard fared ill, Army Aide Gong Hu died in battle, and arrows reached Wen's horse's head.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shi led out his entire force to fight at the Zha Bridge outside Chengdu; Huan Wen's vanguard fared badly, army aide Gong Hu was killed in battle, and arrows struck Huan Wen's horse in the head.

sentences.zh: 眾懼，欲退，而鼓吏誤鳴進鼓；

translations.literal: The host was afraid and wished to retreat, but the drum officer mistakenly sounded the advance drum;
translations.idiomatic: The troops panicked and wished to retreat, but the drum officer mistakenly sounded the advance drum;

sentences.zh: 袁喬拔劍督士卒力戰，遂大破之。

translations.literal: Yuan Qiao drew his sword and urged the soldiers to fight with force, and thereby routed them greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Qiao drew his sword and drove the soldiers to fight with all their strength, and won a great victory.

sentences.zh: 溫乘勝長驅至成都，縱火燒其城門。

translations.literal: Wen, riding victory, drove far and reached Chengdu, and set fire to burn its gate towers.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Wen, pressing his advantage, drove straight to Chengdu and set fire to its gates.

sentences.zh: 漢人惶懼，無復鬥志。

translations.literal: Han men were fearful and alarmed and had no further will to fight.
translations.idiomatic: The Han troops were terrified and lost all will to fight.

sentences.zh: 勢夜開東門走，至葭萌，使散騎常侍王幼送降文於溫，自稱「略陽李勢叩頭死罪」，尋輿櫬面縛詣軍門。

translations.literal: Shi by night opened the east gate and fled; reaching Jiameng, he sent Regular Attendant of the Scattered Riders Wang You to deliver a surrender document to Wen, styling himself "Li Shi of Lueyang, kowtowing in capital offense"; soon he came in a coffin-cart, face bound, to the army gate.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shi opened the east gate by night and fled; reaching Jiameng, he sent Regular Attendant of the Scattered Riders Wang You to deliver his surrender to Huan Wen, signing himself "Li Shi of Lueyang, kowtowing in mortal guilt"; soon he came to the army gate in a coffin-cart with his face bound.

sentences.zh: 溫解縛焚櫬，送勢及宗室十餘人於建康；

translations.literal: Wen released his bonds, burned the coffin-cart, and sent Shi and more than ten of the imperial clan to Jiankang;
translations.idiomatic: Huan Wen released his bonds, burned the coffin-cart, and sent Li Shi and more than ten members of the imperial clan to Jiankang;

sentences.zh: 引漢司空譙獻之等以為參佐，舉賢旌善，蜀人悅之。

translations.literal: he brought in Han Minister of Works Qiao Xianzhi and others as aides, elevated the worthy and displayed goodness, and Shu men were pleased.
translations.idiomatic: he took Han minister of works Qiao Xianzhi and others as his aides, promoted the worthy and honored the good, and the people of Shu were pleased.

sentences.zh: 日南太守夏侯覽貪縱，侵刻胡商，又科調船材，雲欲有所討，由是諸國恚憤。

translations.literal: Rinan Prefect Xiahou Lan was greedy and unrestrained, encroached upon and exploited barbarian merchants, and also levied ship timber, saying he intended some campaign—thereby the various states were resentful and enraged.
translations.idiomatic: Rinan prefect Xiahou Lan was greedy and unrestrained, cheated and exploited foreign merchants, and also levied ship timber on the pretext of mounting a campaign—so that the various states were filled with resentment.

sentences.zh: 林邑王文攻陷日南，將士死者五六千，殺覽，以屍祭天。

translations.literal: Lin Yi King Wen attacked and took Rinan; officers and soldiers who died numbered five or six thousand; he killed Lan and used the corpse to sacrifice to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Yi king Fan Wen attacked and captured Rinan; five or six thousand officers and soldiers died; he killed Lan and offered his corpse as a sacrifice to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 檄交州刺史朱蕃，請以郡北橫山為界。

translations.literal: He issued a proclamation to Jiaozhi Inspector Zhu Fan, requesting that north of the commandery Mount Heng serve as the border.
translations.idiomatic: He sent a proclamation to Jiaozhi inspector Zhu Fan, requesting that Mount Heng north of the commandery serve as the border.

sentences.zh: 文既去，蕃使督護劉雄戍日南。

translations.literal: After Wen had departed, Fan had Supervisor Liu Xiong garrison Rinan.
translations.idiomatic: After Fan Wen had withdrawn, Zhu Fan sent supervisor Liu Xiong to garrison Rinan.

sentences.zh: 漢故尚書僕射王誓、鎮東將軍鄧定、平南將軍王潤、將軍隗文等皆舉兵反，眾各萬餘。

translations.literal: Former Han Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Shi, Eastern Pacification General Deng Ding, Southern Pacification General Wang Run, General Kui Wen, and others all raised troops in revolt, each host numbering more than ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Former Han vice director of the masters of writing Wang Shi, Eastern Pacification General Deng Ding, Southern Pacification General Wang Run, general Kui Wen, and others all rose in revolt, each with a force of more than ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 桓溫自擊定，使袁喬擊文，皆破之。

translations.literal: Huan Wen himself struck Ding and had Yuan Qiao strike Wen; he broke them all.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Wen himself attacked Deng Ding and had Yuan Qiao attack Kui Wen; both were defeated.

sentences.zh: 溫命益州刺史周撫鎮彭模，斬王誓、王潤。

translations.literal: Wen ordered Yi Province Inspector Zhou Fu to garrison Pengmo and beheaded Wang Shi and Wang Run.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Wen ordered Yi Province inspector Zhou Fu to garrison Pengmo and executed Wang Shi and Wang Run.

sentences.zh: 溫留成都三十日，振旅還江陵。

translations.literal: Wen remained at Chengdu thirty days, put the army in order, and returned to Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Wen remained at Chengdu thirty days, reorganized his troops, and returned to Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 李勢至建康，封歸義侯。

translations.literal: Li Shi reached Jiankang and was enfeoffed Marquis of Guiyi.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shi reached Jiankang and was enfeoffed as Marquis of Guiyi.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，丁巳，鄧定、隗文等入據成都，征虜將軍楊謙棄涪城，退保德陽。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on dingsi, Deng Ding, Kui Wen, and others entered and seized Chengdu; Campaign General Yang Qian abandoned Fucheng and withdrew to guard Deyang.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the dingsi day, Deng Ding, Kui Wen, and others seized Chengdu; campaign general Yang Qian abandoned Fucheng and withdrew to Deyang.

sentences.zh: 趙涼州刺史麻秋攻枹罕。

translations.literal: Zhao Liang Province Inspector Ma Qiu attacked Fuhan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Liang Province inspector Ma Qiu attacked Fuhan.

sentences.zh: 晉昌太守郎坦以城大難守，欲棄外城。

translations.literal: Jinchang Prefect Lang Tan, because the city was large and hard to defend, wished to abandon the outer city.
translations.idiomatic: Jinchang prefect Lang Tan, finding the city too large to defend, wished to abandon the outer city.

sentences.zh: 武成太守張悛曰：「棄外城則動眾心，大事去矣。

translations.literal: Wucheng Prefect Zhang Shuan said, "If we abandon the outer city, we will shake the host's hearts and the great affair is lost.
translations.idiomatic: Wucheng prefect Zhang Shuan said, "If we abandon the outer city, we will shake the troops' morale and the cause is lost.

sentences.zh: 」寧戎校尉張璩從悛言，固守大城。

translations.literal: " Ningrong Commandant Zhang Qu followed Shuan's words and firmly held the great city.
translations.idiomatic: " Ningrong commandant Zhang Qu followed Zhang Shuan's advice and held firm to the inner city.

sentences.zh: 秋帥眾八萬，圍塹數重，雲梯地突，百道皆進。

translations.literal: In autumn Qiu led a host of eighty thousand, encircled with trench rings many layers deep, cloud-ladders and mining tunnels, a hundred routes all advancing.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn Ma Qiu mustered eighty thousand men, threw up trench rings layer upon layer, and pushed forward with siege towers, sappers, and assaults from every quarter.

sentences.zh: 城中御之，秋眾死傷數萬。
